name: gitlab
description: GitLab CE 19.4.8 by the publisher's image index digest. Config, data and logs share /data. Create stopped, set GITLAB_EXTERNAL_URL to the owner's http/https URL, then start. Arca generates GITLAB_ROOT_PASSWORD for a fresh install. Link the edge to HTTP 80 for external HTTPS; no host listener or SSH port. Check /-/readiness manually. Not yet run on a live node; rehearse first. See docs/GITLAB-MIGRATION.md for the runbook and optional SSH variant.
